meta.purpose: Knowledge base for a Rwanda-only tourism RAG assistant
important_notes: Prices, permits and advisories change often and sources disagree. Every record has last_verified and source_urls; the app should show 'check official sources (RDB, your government)' next to costs and safety.
source_confidence: high = multiple consistent sources or official; medium = operator/aggregator sources; low = thin sourcing, verify before relying.
Most sources are tour-operator sites, not official RDB pages. Before launch, verify costs against visitrwanda.com / rdb.rw.

seasons.rains: March-May and October-November (heavier rains can affect trails and roads)

points: Fighting in eastern DRC affects border areas. Several governments (Australia, Ireland) advise against travel to Rubavu district incl. Gisenyi; the US advises against travel within 10 km of the DRC border in Rubavu and Rusizi.

An Ebola outbreak in DRC was announced on 17 May 2026; one government source says travellers who were in DRC in the previous 30 days are denied entry to Rwanda. DRC land borders may close at short notice.
Advisory levels differ by country and change; Kigali, Akagera and interior circuits are described as the more stable areas, but travellers should check their own government's advice.

places.name: Volcanoes National Park
places.best_season: Dry seasons (June-September and mid-December-February) give easier, less muddy treks; trekking runs year-round.
places.description: Rwandan slice of the Virunga volcanoes and the home of habituated mountain gorilla families. Treks start with a morning briefing at Kinigi and allow one hour with a gorilla family.
places.costs_note: Foreign non-resident gorilla permit is reported at USD 1,500 per person (set by RDB; same price quoted for 2026 and 2027). Residents about USD 500, Rwandan/EAC citizens about USD 200. Daily supply is capped (sources say 96 or 112 permits/day, 12 or 14 families). One operator site mentions a 30% discount (USD 1,050) for Nov-May when combined with Nyungwe/Akagera, but other sources say the price is fixed, so confirm with RDB. Book 3-6 months ahead.
places.safety_note: Part of the park borders the DRC. Some governments advise extra caution or reconsidering travel near the border; permits were reportedly paused during past security incidents. Follow RDB guidance.
places.access_from_kigali: Roughly 2 hours by road to Musanze/Kinigi (approximate).
tips: Book permits through RDB or a licensed operator early
Pack rain gear and sturdy boots
Gorilla treks are physically demanding; ask about difficulty level

places.name: Nyungwe Forest National Park
places.best_season: Dry seasons (June-September, December-February) for easier trails; the forest is wet and misty year-round.
places.description: One of Africa's oldest montane rainforests, known for chimpanzee tracking, colobus and other monkeys, rich birdlife, and a canopy walkway about 60-70 m above the forest floor.
places.costs_note: Reported fees vary by source and date: canopy walk about USD 40-80 for international visitors; chimpanzee trekking reported from USD 90 up to about USD 150; park entry fees may add to this. Treat as approximate and confirm with RDB.
places.safety_note: Parts of Rusizi district near the DRC border are covered by some travel advisories; the forest itself is generally treated as a standard tourism circuit.
tips: Chimp permits are limited, so book early

places.name: Akagera National Park
places.best_season: Dry seasons (June-September and mid-December-February) for wildlife viewing; accessible year-round.
places.description: Rwanda's only savannah park, with lakes, papyrus swamps and rolling plains. Lions were reintroduced in 2015 and black rhinos in 2017, so all Big Five are present, though sightings are not guaranteed.
places.costs_note: Entry fees depend on visitor category and length of stay; operator sites quote roughly USD 50-100 per day for non-residents. Reported extras: ranger guide about USD 25 half-day / USD 40 full-day, night drive about USD 40. Confirm current rates with the park.
places.safety_note: Generally treated as one of the safer, interior tourism circuits.
places.access_from_kigali: About 110 km, roughly 2-2.5 hours by road.
tips: A guide helps a lot with finding lions

places.name: Gishwati-Mukura National Park
places.description: Rwanda's newest national park, made of two small forest fragments (Gishwati and Mukura) being restored. Home to a small chimpanzee group, golden monkeys, L'Hoest's and blue monkeys.
places.costs_note: Fees not verified; check with RDB.
places.safety_note: Located in the west; check current advisories for nearby border districts.
places.access_from_kigali: Typically reached from the Lake Kivu / Karongi side (distance not verified).

places.name: Lake Kivu - Karongi (Kibuye)
places.best_season: Dry seasons for hiking and cycling; March-May and October-November downpours can affect trails.
places.description: Quiet lakeside town with hills, islands and lodges, often described as calmer than Gisenyi. A good base for the Congo Nile Trail and boat or kayak trips.
places.costs_note: Costs vary by lodge and activity; not standardized.
places.safety_note: Karongi is not in the border districts named in most advisories, but check current guidance for the lake area.
places.access_from_kigali: Several hours by road (distance not verified).

places.name: Lake Kivu - Rubavu (Gisenyi)
places.description: Largest resort town on Lake Kivu, known for beaches and nightlife. It sits next to the DRC border crossing at Goma.
places.safety_note: IMPORTANT: several governments (e.g. Australia, Ireland) advise against travel to Rubavu district including Gisenyi due to instability and cross-border risk; the US advises against travel within 10 km of the DRC border in Rubavu. Recommend alternatives such as Karongi unless the user has checked current advice.
tips: Check your own government's travel advisory before choosing this destination

places.name: Lake Kivu - Rusizi (Cyangugu/Kamembe)
interests: southern end of Congo Nile Trail
places.description: Less-visited southern end of Lake Kivu near the Nyungwe gateway, with a small airport at Kamembe.
places.safety_note: Parts of Rusizi within 10 km of the DRC border are under 'reconsider travel' or 'do not travel' advice from several governments. Check current advisories and the exact location of lodgings.
places.access_from_kigali: Long road trip; Kamembe airport nearby.

places.name: Congo Nile Trail
places.best_season: Dry seasons; avoid March-May and October-November downpours for multi-day trips.
places.description: About 227 km route along Lake Kivu from Rubavu in the north to Rusizi in the south, split into stages. Passes tea plantations, coffee washing stations and rural villages; suited to hiking or mountain biking, with guides and simple lodging.
places.costs_note: Packages reported from about USD 1,300 for an all-inclusive 8-day tour; independent travel can be cheaper.
places.safety_note: The northern start (Rubavu/Gisenyi) and southern end (Rusizi) are affected by border-area advisories. Consider doing only the middle section around Karongi, and check advice first.
places.access_from_kigali: Transfers to start points take several hours.

places.name: Kigali Genocide Memorial
places.description: Place of remembrance and learning for victims of the 1994 genocide against the Tutsi, with permanent exhibitions and mass graves holding the remains of over 250,000 people. Often recommended as the first stop to understand modern Rwanda.
places.costs_note: Check the official site for current opening and entry details.
places.safety_note: A solemn site; dress respectfully and follow guidance on photography.
tips: Photography rules apply in some areas

places.name: Kandt House Museum of Natural History
places.description: Former home of Richard Kandt, the first German colonial resident, in what is considered Kigali's first modern house. Exhibits cover pre-colonial life, the colonial period, Kigali's history and natural history, including live reptiles.

places.name: Inema Arts Centre
places.description: Gallery and creative hub founded in 2012 by two Rwandan painters, showing contemporary Rwandan paintings, sculpture and mixed media. Also hosts dance, concerts and workshops.
places.costs_note: Entry and event pricing varies; contact the centre.

places.name: Kimironko Market
places.description: Large local market with fresh produce, fabrics and handmade crafts, popular for souvenirs and everyday Kigali life.
places.safety_note: Watch your belongings in crowded areas.

places.name: Nyamirambo Women's Centre Walk
places.description: Guided walk through the Nyamirambo neighbourhood run by a women's cooperative, with local food, crafts and everyday urban life.
places.costs_note: Booking and prices set by the centre; confirm directly.

places.name: Rwanda Art Museum
places.description: Housed in the former Presidential Palace, it shows contemporary art from Rwanda and abroad. Older sources call it the Presidential Palace Museum.

places.name: Campaign Against Genocide Museum
places.description: Museum located in the Parliament building covering the 1994 liberation, with a viewpoint over the city.

places.name: King's Palace Museum (Rukari), Nyanza
places.description: Reconstruction of the traditional royal residence, a beehive-shaped thatched dwelling, with insight into pre-colonial court life and the monarchy that ended in 1962. Descendants of the royal long-horned herd are kept nearby. Opened as a museum in 2008.
tips: Combine with the Ethnographic Museum in Huye

places.name: Ethnographic Museum of Rwanda, Huye
places.description: Rwanda's oldest national museum, inaugurated in 1989, holding more than 10,000 artefacts on traditional clothing, crafts, tools, instruments and beliefs.

places.name: Iby'Iwacu Cultural Village
places.best_season: Year-round; good rest-day activity between gorilla treks.
places.description: Community-run cultural village near Volcanoes National Park, set up to give former poachers a tourism-based livelihood. Visitors see traditional dance, crafts and village life.
places.costs_note: Package prices vary; one operator listed about USD 100 per person for groups of 7+ (not an official rate). Confirm directly.
places.safety_note: Near the Volcanoes area; follow general northern-border guidance.
places.access_from_kigali: Near Musanze/Kinigi, about 2 hours from Kigali (approximate).

places.name: Lake Muhazi
places.description: Lake east of Kigali that suits a quiet day trip for boating, fishing and birdwatching.
